repairs_and_rejected_candidates: Initial private Gruntz normalization incorrectly treated a winding complex scale as positive beneath principal roots. An independent exact two-subsequence proof rejects the false finite; a neutral scale and rational dependence certificate now precede positive normalization. Affine Laplace now returns exp(beta*s)*expint(1,beta*s)/a on its existing guarded domain. This intentionally corrects the inherited complex branch bug; the reference reciprocal Laplace table is also incorrect and is not used as the oracle.

performance.scope: Five measured LRT families improve 2.26x–3.23x; repeated calls after input construction, no whole-engine gain or completeness claim.

remaining_gaps: Global mathematical parity is not certified. The documented-example replay still has 278 differing objects requiring scoped review; ODE corpus completeness remains open.

The complex winding example remains undecided rather than falsely finite; other finite shifted-difference/root examples may remain held. The four remaining strict xfails are enumerated separately; issue 22210 remains another tracked capability gap.
E1 repair covers the two existing affine reciprocal/logarithm rules and their certified shifts/moments, preserving guards and ROC. General transform branch completeness is not established.
